find:
if self.turn_start is not None:
                        self.result.last_update_seconds = time.monotonic() - self.turn_start
replace:
if self.turn_start is not None and self.result.last_update_seconds is None:
                        self.result.last_update_seconds = time.monotonic() - self.turn_start

find:
if self.turn_start is not None:
                        self.result.last_update_seconds = time.monotonic() - self.turn_start
